steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and lightly grease a 24-cup mini-muffin tin with canola oil.
Combine mashed banana, unsweetened applesauce, sunflower seed butter, and vanilla extract in a large bowl.
Add rolled oats, cinnamon, and baking powder to the bowl.
Stir until a thick, uniform batter forms with no dry patches.
Spoon the batter evenly into all 24 cups of the mini-muffin tin.
Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, until the tops are set and lightly golden.
Let cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
Serve once fully cooled to a safe temperature. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for 2 days, or refrigerate for up to 5 days.
